docs.title: Walker TienKung Pro: ARM Board Deployment (Jetson AGX Orin)
docs.text:
In-depth reference for the self-contained bundle at ubt_IL/scripts/deploy/tienkung_pro/arm_64/: runtime architecture, environment build, on-board training, and troubleshooting. Runtime: Jetson AGX Orin 8GB. The project supports both ARM containers and Conda, but on-board memory is limited; a lightweight Conda environment is recommended. Step-by-step instructions: Real-robot workflow · Option B: on-board deployment.

  • Target: Jetson AGX Orin (TienKung Orin1 control board 192.168.41.2; JetPack 6 / L4T R36.4.0 / Ubuntu 22.04 / glibc 2.35 / CUDA 12.6)
  • PROJECT_ROOT = /home/nvidia/vla/Thinker-IL-LAB/ubt_IL
  • Design principle: host scripts use PROJECT_ROOT + CLI overrides instead of the container paths hard-coded in the original scripts (/ubt_IL/..., /lerobot/.venv/bin/...). No sudo, no symlinks, no modification of the original scripts.

docs.title: 1. Runtime architecture (dual Python stacks)
docs.text:
The core idea is a division of labor between two Python stacks: env_vla (3.12) runs LeRobot inference/training, while system Python 3.10 runs hardware services that require cp310 (pyorbbecsdk camera, ROS 2 bridge). They are decoupled over ZMQ and do not pollute each other.

env_vla (conda, Python 3.12):  LeRobot + tienkung plugin + torch
   │  lerobot-rollout inference / lerobot-train training / image_client path check
   │
   ├── 5558 ◄── ImageServer (system py3.10 + pyorbbecsdk) ──► camera
   │
   └── 5559 ──► Bridge2 (system py3.10 + ROS 2) ──ROS 2 DDS──► TienKung hardware
       5560 ◄──┘
ZMQ port Direction Purpose Started by 5558 ImageServer -> env_vla Camera JPEG frames image_server_host.sh (manual, long-running) 5559 env_vla -> Bridge2 Action commands The plugin starts Bridge2 automatically during rollout 5560 Bridge2 -> env_vla Robot status Same as above

Stack ownership:

  • env_vla (3.12): rollout_host.sh, train_host.sh, image_client_host.sh. Contains torch / LeRobot / the tienkung plugin; run conda activate env_vla first.
  • System python3 /usr/bin/python3 (3.10.12) + /opt/ros/humble: image_server_host.sh, robot_ready.sh, and Bridge2 (started by the plugin with /usr/bin/python3; no rclpy needed in env_vla).

state/action are 26D, ordered [left arm 7 | right arm 7 | left hand 6 | right hand 6] (defined by TienKungRobotConfig.all_joints).

docs.title: 2. Files
docs.text: File Purpose Stack setup_env.sh One-shot build of the conda env env_vla (Python 3.12 + local wheels + LeRobot + tienkung plugin), with an import self-check at the end Builder (conda) rollout_host.sh Policy inference deployment (lerobot-rollout) env_vla (3.12) train_host.sh ACT training (lerobot-train, optional) env_vla (3.12) image_server_host.sh Camera image service: camera -> ZMQ 5558 (JPEG) System py3.10 + pyorbbecsdk image_client_host.sh / image_client.py Camera path validation client (receives frames on 5558, reports fps/latency and a verdict) env_vla (3.12) robot_ready.sh Reset the robot to the preset pose (ready pose before inference) System py3.10 + ROS 2 torch-*-cp312-cp312-linux_aarch64.whl Locally built PyTorch / torchvision wheels (Jetson-specific) -

docs.title: 3. Environment setup (first time)
docs.text:
Prerequisites:

  • Project code copied to /home/nvidia/vla/Thinker-IL-LAB/ (see step 0 of Real-robot workflow · Option B).
  • conda installed (miniconda / miniforge).
  • ROS 2 Humble on the host (/opt/ros/humble, including rclpy, bodyctrl_msgs, cv_bridge).
  • System Python 3.10 has pyorbbecsdk2 / cv2 / zmq / numpy (under ~/.local). Install missing ones with: 
    python3 -m pip install evdev pyorbbecsdk2
  • Real deployment: change 192.168.41.99 in ubt_IL/docker/fastdds_no_shm.xml to the IP of the NIC directly connected to the robot (keep 127.0.0.1), otherwise ROS 2 DDS cannot reach the robot.

Build:

cd /home/nvidia/vla/Thinker-IL-LAB/ubt_IL/scripts/deploy/tienkung_pro/arm_64
bash setup_env.sh          # create conda env_vla (python=3.12), install wheels + LeRobot + plugin, self-check
Variable Default Description CONDA_BASE conda info --base or ~/miniconda3 conda installation root ENV_NAME env_vla conda environment name PIP_MIRROR Tsinghua TUNA pip mirror

After the build, conda activate env_vla and which python should point to env_vla (Python 3.12).

docs.title: 4. Deployment inference
docs.text:
Standard order (full steps in Real-robot workflow · Option B): start the camera service first, then inference. The camera service runs on system Python 3.10 and must stay resident in a separate terminal or in the background.

bash image_server_host.sh    # ① camera service (system py3.10, separate terminal / background)
bash robot_ready.sh          # ② (optional) reset the robot to the preset pose (system py3.10 + ROS 2)
conda activate env_vla       # ③ policy inference (env_vla 3.12, new terminal)
bash rollout_host.sh

Common rollout_host.sh overrides:

POLICY_PATH=$PROJECT_ROOT/model/tienkung_pick_up_act/checkpoints/100000/pretrained_model \
DURATION=60 bash rollout_host.sh

# Deploy a 13-DOF model (right arm 7 + right hand 6; JOINT_CONFIG must match training)
JOINT_CONFIG=tienkung_13 \
POLICY_PATH=$PROJECT_ROOT/model/sim_pick_place_right13_act/checkpoints/last/pretrained_model \
DURATION=60 bash rollout_host.sh

DISPLAY_CAM=false bash rollout_host.sh        # disable camera display over SSH without X
Variable Default Description POLICY_PATH $PROJECT_ROOT/model/Pick_up_tiangong_all_act/checkpoints/last/pretrained_model ACT checkpoint JOINT_CONFIG tienkung_26 Joint DOF config (tienkung_26 = full 26; tienkung_13 = right arm 7 + right hand 6); must match the training DOF STRATEGY base Inference strategy (base autonomous; sentry/highlight/dagger for recording/interaction) TASK sim_pick_place Task description (injected as the policy condition) ZMQ_HOST 127.0.0.1 image_server address (change to the robot IP when the camera runs there) DURATION 60 Run time (seconds) FPS 30 Control loop rate (aligned with training fps) DISPLAY_CAM true Camera display (set false for SSH without X)

docs.title: Verify the camera path
docs.text:
Before starting rollout, use image_client (env_vla side) to connect to 5558 and verify frames. No GUI required:

bash image_client_host.sh --count 60               # receive 60 frames, exit and report
bash image_client_host.sh --show                   # preview window (requires X: ssh -X/-Y or local DISPLAY=:0)
bash image_client_host.sh --address 192.168.41.2   # connect to image_server on the robot

=> Camera path OK ✓ means the path is healthy.

docs.title: 5. On-board training (optional)
docs.text:
conda activate env_vla
bash train_host.sh
STEPS=100000 BATCH_SIZE=8 bash train_host.sh
Variable Default Description CONFIG_PATH $PROJECT_ROOT/scripts/deploy/train_config_tiangong_all.json Training config DATASET_ROOT $PROJECT_ROOT/dataset LeRobotDataset root DATASET_REPO_ID Pick_up_the_apple_all Must match the actual dataset directory name (overrides the config repo_id) OUTPUT_DIR $PROJECT_ROOT/model/Pick_up_tiangong_all_act Output directory STEPS 500000 Training steps BATCH_SIZE 8 Batch size SEED 10000 Random seed DEVICE cuda Training device HF_HUB_OFFLINE 1 Offline training (no HuggingFace Hub access)

Note: the config's repo_id=Pick_up_tiangong_all does not match the actual dataset directory Pick_up_the_apple_all; the script defaults to DATASET_REPO_ID=Pick_up_the_apple_all to match it. Keep them consistent if you change either.

docs.title: 6. Dataset replay (optional)
docs.text:
/usr/bin/python3 $PROJECT_ROOT/scripts/deploy/replay.py \
    --dataset $PROJECT_ROOT/dataset/Pick_up_the_apple_all --episode 0 --rate 30

docs.title: 7. Notes and troubleshooting
docs.text:
• Python 3.12: LeRobot 0.5.2 and the tienkung plugin run natively without source patches; do not downgrade to 3.10.
  • Local wheels: torch/torchvision use the cp312 wheels in this directory (Jetson-specific, linked against glibc 2.35). Do not use PyPI aarch64 wheels (CPU-only, no CUDA) or prebuilt wheels requiring GLIBC_2.38 (they crash on 2.35).
  • numpy must be <2: the local torch was built against numpy 1.x; 2.x triggers a "compiled using NumPy 1.x" crash. setup_env.sh pins numpy==1.26.4; do not upgrade it.
  • Do not mix stacks: image_server_host.sh and robot_ready.sh use system Python 3.10 and do not need conda activate env_vla; rollout_host.sh, train_host.sh, and image_client_host.sh use env_vla (3.12) and require activation.
  • Camera display: DISPLAY_CAM=true and image_client --show need X; set false or use ssh -X/-Y when DISPLAY is absent.
  • conda activate fails: in non-interactive shells, run source $CONDA_BASE/etc/profile.d/conda.sh before conda activate env_vla (the scripts handle this).
  • Disk: env_vla with torch is about 1.5 GB and eMMC is tight; pip always uses --no-cache-dir.
  • Jetson inference crashes (numpy): numpy was upgraded to 2.x; rerun setup_env.sh and keep numpy==1.26.4.

docs.title: Walker TienKung Pro: Imitation Learning Platform
docs.text:
Code: ubt_IL/scripts/{convert,train,eval,deploy} (run inside the container) Prerequisite: repository cloned and submodules initialized as described in Getting Started; HDF5 data ready (simulation collection or real-robot collection)

This page documents the shared conversion/training/evaluation/deployment workflow and configuration parameters for Walker TienKung Pro. Data-source-specific commands are embedded in the corresponding workflow pages.

docs.title: 1. Environment (ubt_IL container)
docs.text: See Imitation Learning Platform · Container Setup for build / start / bash. Run all remaining commands inside the container.

docs.title: 2. Data conversion (HDF5 -> LeRobot)
docs.text:
Script: /ubt_IL/scripts/convert/tienkung_pro/convert.sh. It converts raw HDF5 into a LeRobot v3 dataset at /ubt_IL/dataset/<REPO_ID>/.

Conversion command (values for each variable are described in the config and environment tables below):

CONFIG=<conversion config JSON> \
SRC_ROOT=<HDF5 source directory> \
TGT_PATH=<LeRobot output root> \
REPO_ID=<output dataset name> \
TASK_NAME=<task name> \
bash /ubt_IL/scripts/convert/tienkung_pro/convert.sh

Examples:

  • Simulation data: Simulation workflow · Data conversion
  • Real-robot data: Real-robot workflow · Data conversion

Conversion configs live in /ubt_IL/scripts/convert/tienkung_pro/configs/ and include field filtering and mapping. Choose or adapt one for your training needs:

Config Dimension Scenario Tien_Kung_13_1RGB_sim.json 13D (right arm 7 + right hand 6) Simulation (recommended, avoids left-arm dead dimensions) tienkung_pro_26d_1RGB.json 26D, both arms Simulation (dual-arm scenario) tienkung_pro_26d_1RGB_real.json 26D, both arms, RGB only Real robot (real HDF5 has no depth stream) tienkung_pro_13d_1RGB.json 13D Real robot

Common environment variables (defaults can be omitted; see bash convert.sh -h and Data Conversion):

Variable Description SRC_ROOT HDF5 root (one subdirectory per episode, each containing trajectory.hdf5; default /ubt_IL/dataset/tienkung_pro) TGT_PATH LeRobot output root (default /ubt_IL/dataset) CONFIG Conversion config JSON (see the table above) REPO_ID Output dataset name (keep it consistent with training) TASK_NAME Task name (written to each frame's task field and used as the language condition during training) FPS Target frame rate (default 15) ROBOT_TYPE Robot type (default tienkung) VCODEC Video codec (default h264) HDF5_REL_PATH HDF5 path relative to each episode directory (default trajectory.hdf5) TRIM_STATIONARY 1 enables stationary-frame trimming (see below) STATIONARY_DIAGNOSE 1 only reports the stationary distribution without writing data (for threshold calibration) RESAMPLE_FPS Target frame rate; enables resampling when set (disabled by default)

Stationary-frame trimming

Stationary frames can trap the policy in a local stationary loop. Set TRIM_STATIONARY=1 to trim stationary runs longer than the cap (default 8 frames). Prefix the conversion command with TRIM_STATIONARY=1 \.

Output: a LeRobot v3 dataset under /ubt_IL/dataset/<REPO_ID>/ (meta/, chunk-000/ data parquet, videos/).

docs.title: 3. Data visualization
docs.text:
After conversion, inspect dataset quality with lerobot-dataset-viz. Checking data before training is important to avoid training blindly:

HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 lerobot-dataset-viz \
  --repo-id <REPO_ID> \
  --episode-index 0 \
  --root /ubt_IL/dataset/<REPO_ID>

Note: --root must point to the dataset directory containing meta/ (the repo_id directory itself), not its parent. HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 disables access to the HuggingFace Hub.

Examples: Simulation workflow · Visualization / Real-robot workflow · Visualization.

docs.title: 4. Policy training
docs.text:
Training script: /ubt_IL/scripts/train/tienkung_pro/train.sh; configs in /ubt_IL/scripts/train/tienkung_pro/configs/.

Training command (optional overrides are listed below; unset values come from the config file):

CONFIG_PATH=<training config JSON> \
OUTPUT_DIR=<model output directory> \
STEPS=<training steps> SAVE_FREQ=<save interval> BATCH_SIZE=<batch size> \
bash /ubt_IL/scripts/train/tienkung_pro/train.sh

Examples:

  • Simulation training: Simulation workflow · Training
  • Real-robot training: Real-robot workflow · Training

Without train.sh (call lerobot-train directly from /ubt_IL/lerobot):

cd /ubt_IL/lerobot
HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 /lerobot/.venv/bin/lerobot-train \
  --config_path=/ubt_IL/scripts/train/tienkung_pro/configs/train_config_tienkung_pro_sim_pick_place.json \
  --output_dir=/ubt_IL/model/tienkung_sim_pick_place_act \
  --steps=80000 --save_freq=20000 --batch_size=8

Common overrides (unset values come from the config file):

Variable Description CONFIG_PATH Training config JSON; ⚠️ train.sh defaults to the simulation config, so real-robot training must specify the real config explicitly DATASET_REPO_ID / DATASET_ROOT Dataset name / root (must match the conversion REPO_ID; DATASET_ROOT must be the dataset directory containing meta/) OUTPUT_DIR Model output directory (checkpoints under checkpoints/last/pretrained_model/) STEPS Training steps SAVE_FREQ Checkpoint save interval (steps) BATCH_SIZE Batch size RESUME Resume training (true makes CONFIG_PATH point to train_config.json inside the checkpoint)

docs.title: 5. Policy evaluation (offline MSE)
docs.text:
Script: /ubt_IL/scripts/eval/eval_policy.py. It runs offline inference over a LeRobot dataset, computes the per-frame MSE between predicted and ground-truth actions, and can plot per-episode comparisons. Quantify policy quality before deployment.

Evaluation command:

/lerobot/.venv/bin/python /ubt_IL/scripts/eval/eval_policy.py \
  --policy-path <ACT checkpoint pretrained_model directory> \
  --dataset-path <LeRobot dataset directory containing meta/info.json> \
  --episodes <number of episodes> \
  --inference-freq <infer every N steps> \
  --plot --plot-dir <plot output directory> \
  --output <result JSON path> \
  --device cuda

Examples:

  • Simulation model: Simulation workflow · Evaluation
  • Real-robot model: Real-robot workflow · Evaluation
Argument Description --policy-path Trained ACT checkpoint (the pretrained_model directory) --dataset-path LeRobot dataset root (containing meta/info.json) --episodes Number of episodes to evaluate (default: all) --inference-freq Run inference every N steps to emulate the deployment chunk queue; defaults to policy.n_action_steps; 1 means every step --plot / --plot-dir Per-episode prediction-vs-ground-truth plots (PNG) --output Result JSON (summary + per-episode MSE) --device cuda (default; falls back to cpu when unavailable)

Once evaluation passes, continue with §6 Model deployment.

docs.title: 6. Model deployment
docs.text:
Script: /ubt_IL/scripts/deploy/tienkung_pro/rollout.sh. It loads a trained ACT checkpoint, runs inference at the control rate, and sends actions to the simulator or real robot over ZMQ. Helper tools: reset.py (initialize/reset pose), replay.py (replay dataset actions for validation), image_client.py (camera path validation).

Deployment command (optional variables are listed below; unset values use script defaults):

POLICY_PATH=<ACT checkpoint pretrained_model directory> \
JOINT_CONFIG=<joint DOF config> \
ZMQ_HOST=<simulator/robot address> \
TASK=<task description> \
bash /ubt_IL/scripts/deploy/tienkung_pro/rollout.sh

Examples:

  • Simulation deployment (feedback into the simulator; recommended first): Simulation workflow · Model deployment
  • Real-robot deployment (option A remote container / option B Jetson board / custom DOF): Real-robot workflow · Model deployment

Common environment variables:

Variable Description POLICY_PATH Trained ACT checkpoint (checkpoints/<step>/pretrained_model) JOINT_CONFIG Joint DOF config: tienkung_26 = full 26, tienkung_13 = right arm 7 + right hand 6; custom configs are supported and must match the training DOF STRATEGY Execution strategy (base = autonomous execution) ZMQ_HOST Target address: simulation 127.0.0.1 (default); hardware must override it (e.g. 192.168.41.2) FPS Control rate (aligned with training fps, default 15) DURATION Run time (seconds, default 60) TASK Task description

docs.title: FAQ
docs.text: Symptom Fix Normalization explodes during training (QUANTILES NaN/Inf) Constant dimensions in the data (e.g. a locked left arm in 26D); convert with the 13D config to drop dead dimensions Trajectory contains long stationary segments; the policy stops during deployment Add TRIM_STATIONARY=1 during conversion Training raises FileExistsError OUTPUT_DIR already exists with RESUME=false; use a new directory or delete the old one Real-robot conversion reports a missing depth stream Real HDF5 has no depth; use tienkung_pro_26d_1RGB_real.json (RGB only) Action dimensions are wrong after conversion The real master gripper is mapped to 6D via invert/repeat/pad; confirm the real config was used, not the sim config Occasional non-convergence Insufficient data; collect more episodes and confirm image_transforms is enabled for generalization

docs.title: Walker TienKung Pro Real-Robot Workflow: Collect -> Convert -> Train -> Evaluate -> Deploy
docs.text:
Robot: Walker TienKung Pro hardware

This guide covers the complete, copy-pasteable flow from raw real-robot HDF5 to a LeRobot dataset, ACT training, offline evaluation, and finally real-robot deployment. Conversion/training/evaluation run in the ubt_IL container; deployment offers a "container" option and a "Jetson host" option.

docs.title: Contents
docs.text:
• 0. Workflow overview
  • 1. Prerequisite: real-robot data collection
  • 2. Start the container (ubt_IL)
  • 3. Data conversion (HDF5 -> LeRobot)
  • 3.1 Conversion command
  • 3.2 Data visualization
  • 4. Policy training
  • 5. Policy evaluation (offline MSE)
  • 6. Model deployment (real robot)
  • Option A: remote container (x86 workstation -> robot)
  • Option B: on-robot Jetson AGX Orin
  • 7. FAQ

docs.title: 0. Workflow overview
docs.text: Real-robot collection (hdf5) --> Data conversion (LeRobot dataset) --> Model training [train.sh ACT] --> Policy evaluation [eval_policy.py] --> Model deployment [rollout.sh] --> Real-robot deployment [robot]

docs.title: 1. Prerequisite: real-robot data collection
docs.text: Data is currently collected with the Thinker Studio teleoperation platform (see the official documentation), which can export LeRobot v3.0 datasets directly. You can also place collected real-robot HDF5 data under /ubt_IL/dataset/hdf5/ (or any SRC_ROOT) and proceed to conversion.

docs.title: 2. Start the container (ubt_IL)
docs.text:
cd ubt_IL/docker

# ⚠️ Must be checked before building: edit interfaceWhiteList in ubt_IL/docker/fastdds_no_shm.xml
# and set <address> to 192.168.41.99 (TienKung direct-link subnet). The file is copied into the image
# at build time, so changes after the build have no effect.
bash run.sh build      # first time
bash run.sh start
bash run.sh bash       # enter the container; run conversion/training/evaluation there

docs.title: 3.1 Conversion command
docs.text:
Script: /ubt_IL/scripts/convert/tienkung_pro/convert.sh Configs: /ubt_IL/scripts/convert/tienkung_pro/configs/, including field filtering and mapping; choose or adapt one for your training needs.

# Real-robot conversion
SRC_ROOT=/ubt_IL/dataset/hdf5 \
TGT_PATH=/ubt_IL/dataset \
CONFIG=/ubt_IL/scripts/convert/tienkung_pro/configs/tienkung_pro_26d_1RGB_real.json \
REPO_ID=real_pick_place \
FPS=15 \
ROBOT_TYPE=tienkung \
TASK_NAME=real_pick_place \
bash /ubt_IL/scripts/convert/tienkung_pro/convert.sh

# Stationary frames can trap the policy in a local stationary loop; enable trimming with TRIM_STATIONARY=1
TRIM_STATIONARY=1 \
SRC_ROOT=/ubt_IL/dataset/hdf5 \
TGT_PATH=/ubt_IL/dataset \
CONFIG=/ubt_IL/scripts/convert/tienkung_pro/configs/tienkung_pro_26d_1RGB_real.json \
REPO_ID=real_pick_place \
FPS=15 \
ROBOT_TYPE=tienkung \
TASK_NAME=real_pick_place \
bash /ubt_IL/scripts/convert/tienkung_pro/convert.sh

Environment variables (defaults can be omitted; see bash convert.sh -h for the rest):

Variable Recommended for hardware Description SRC_ROOT /ubt_IL/dataset/hdf5 Real HDF5 root (one subdirectory per episode containing trajectory.hdf5) TGT_PATH /ubt_IL/dataset (default) LeRobot output root CONFIG configs/tienkung_pro_26d_1RGB_real.json 26D dual arm, head RGB only, action mapped to master (gripper invert/repeat/pad); use tienkung_pro_13d_1RGB.json for 13D real models REPO_ID real_pick_place Output dataset name (keep it consistent with training) FPS 15 Target frame rate ROBOT_TYPE tienkung Robot type TASK_NAME real_pick_place Task name (written to each frame's task field and used as the language condition) VCODEC h264 (default) Video codec HDF5_REL_PATH trajectory.hdf5 (default) HDF5 path relative to each episode directory TRIM_STATIONARY Empty (off) / 1 Stationary-frame trimming: truncate runs longer than the cap (default 8 frames) STATIONARY_DIAGNOSE Empty / 1 Only report the stationary distribution without writing data (for threshold calibration) RESAMPLE_FPS Empty (no resampling) Target frame rate; enables resampling

Multiple real-robot batches can be converted into the same REPO_ID and then merged (e.g. real_merged); use tienkung_pro_13d_1RGB.json for 13D real models.

Output: a LeRobot v3 dataset under /ubt_IL/dataset/<REPO_ID>/ (meta/, chunk-000/ data parquet, videos/).

docs.title: 3.2 Data visualization
docs.text:
Use lerobot-dataset-viz inside the container to inspect the converted dataset. Checking data before training is important to avoid training blindly:

# Inside the container:
HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 lerobot-dataset-viz \
  --repo-id <dataset name> \
  --episode-index 0 \
  --root /ubt_IL/dataset/<dataset name>

Example:

# Visualize the merged TienKung pick-up dataset
HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 lerobot-dataset-viz \
  --repo-id tienkung_pick_up_merged \
  --episode-index 0 \
  --root /ubt_IL/dataset/tienkung_pick_up_merged

Note: --root must point to the dataset directory containing meta/ (the repo_id directory itself), not its parent. HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 disables access to the HuggingFace Hub.

docs.title: 4. Policy training
docs.text:
Training script: /ubt_IL/scripts/train/tienkung_pro/train.sh Configs: /ubt_IL/scripts/train/tienkung_pro/configs/; choose or adapt one for your training needs.

Note: train.sh defaults CONFIG_PATH to the simulation config; real-robot training must specify CONFIG_PATH explicitly.

# Real-robot 26D training (common config overrides)
CONFIG_PATH=/ubt_IL/scripts/train/tienkung_pro/configs/train_config_tienkung_pro_real_pick_place.json \
DATASET_REPO_ID=tienkung_pick_up_merged \
DATASET_ROOT=/ubt_IL/dataset/tienkung_pick_up_merged \
OUTPUT_DIR=/ubt_IL/model/tienkung_pick_up_merged \
bash /ubt_IL/scripts/train/tienkung_pro/train.sh

# Resume (CONFIG_PATH points to train_config.json inside the checkpoint)
CONFIG_PATH=/ubt_IL/model/tienkung_pick_up_merged/checkpoints/last/pretrained_model/train_config.json \
RESUME=true \
bash /ubt_IL/scripts/train/tienkung_pro/train.sh

Without train.sh (call lerobot-train directly with --xxx=yyy overrides; run from /ubt_IL/lerobot):

# Train from scratch
cd /ubt_IL/lerobot
HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 /lerobot/.venv/bin/lerobot-train \
  --config_path=/ubt_IL/scripts/train/tienkung_pro/configs/train_config_tienkung_pro_real_pick_place.json \
  --dataset.repo_id=tienkung_pick_up_merged \
  --dataset.root=/ubt_IL/dataset/tienkung_pick_up_merged \
  --output_dir=/ubt_IL/model/tienkung_pick_up_merged

# Resume
HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 /lerobot/.venv/bin/lerobot-train \
  --config_path=/ubt_IL/model/tienkung_pick_up_merged/checkpoints/last/pretrained_model/train_config.json \
  --resume=true

Common overrides (environment variables for train.sh; unset values come from the config file):

Variable Config default Description CONFIG_PATH Simulation config (train_config_tienkung_pro_sim_pick_place.json) Training config JSON; real-robot training must specify the real config explicitly DATASET_REPO_ID / DATASET_ROOT tienkung_pick_up_merged / /ubt_IL/dataset/tienkung_pick_up_merged Dataset name / root (DATASET_ROOT must be the dataset directory containing meta/, matching the conversion REPO_ID) OUTPUT_DIR /ubt_IL/model/tienkung_pick_up_merged Model output directory (checkpoints under checkpoints/last/pretrained_model/) STEPS 100000 Training steps SAVE_FREQ 10000 Checkpoint save interval (steps) BATCH_SIZE 8 Batch size RESUME false Resume training (true makes CONFIG_PATH point to train_config.json inside the checkpoint)

docs.title: 5. Policy evaluation (offline MSE)
docs.text:
Script: /ubt_IL/scripts/eval/eval_policy.py. It runs offline inference over a LeRobot dataset, computes the per-frame MSE between predicted and ground-truth actions, and can plot per-episode comparisons. Quantify policy quality before deployment.

# Inside the container (LeRobot venv Python)
/lerobot/.venv/bin/python /ubt_IL/scripts/eval/eval_policy.py \
  --policy-path /ubt_IL/model/tienkung_pick_up_act/checkpoints/last/pretrained_model \
  --dataset-path /ubt_IL/dataset/tienkung_pick_up_merged \
  --episodes 5 \
  --inference-freq 1 \
  --plot \
  --plot-dir /ubt_IL/scripts/eval/output/eval_tienkung_pick_up_act \
  --output /ubt_IL/scripts/eval/output/eval_tienkung_pick_up_act/results.json \
  --device cuda

Example output (per-episode prediction vs ground truth):

Main arguments:

Argument Description --policy-path Trained ACT checkpoint (the pretrained_model directory) --dataset-path LeRobot dataset root (containing meta/info.json) --episodes Number of episodes to evaluate (default: all) --inference-freq Run inference every N steps to emulate the deployment chunk queue; defaults to policy.n_action_steps; 1 means every step --plot / --plot-dir Per-episode prediction-vs-ground-truth plots (PNG) --output Result JSON (summary + per-episode MSE) --device cuda (default; falls back to cpu when unavailable)

Output: the console prints Mean/Std/Min/Max MSE and per-joint MSE; --output saves the result JSON and --plot saves comparison plots.

docs.title: Prerequisites:
docs.text:
• The robot is powered on and in half-body motion-control mode.
  • Operation sequence: power on and press A for self-check -> press D to home -> place the robot on the ground, hold A to enter standing mode -> toggle F down and hold A to enter half-body motion control -> toggle E up and proceed. See the TienKung operation guide for remote details.

docs.title: Option A: remote container (x86 workstation -> robot)
Preparation:
docs.text:
• Make sure the workstation and robot are on the same subnet (e.g. 192.168.41.x). Set ROS_DOMAIN_ID=0 and verify the deployment machine can subscribe to robot ROS topics.
  • Start ImageServer on the robot to provide the JPEG stream.
# 0. Build the container
# ⚠️ Robot-specific: check the network config before building. Edit interfaceWhiteList in
# ubt_IL/docker/fastdds_no_shm.xml and set <address> to 192.168.41.99 (TienKung direct-link
# subnet) so it matches the robot subnet. The file is copied into the image at build time;
# changes after the build have no effect, so edit before building.
cd ubt_IL/docker
bash run.sh build
bash run.sh start
bash run.sh bash

# 0.1 Verify the network config after building
echo $FASTRTPS_DEFAULT_PROFILES_FILE
cat /opt/fastdds_no_shm.xml
bash run.sh restart

# 1. Start the camera service on the robot (real deployment only)
# Note: tienkung_pro has three control boards (motion x86, Orin1, Orin2 at 192.168.41.1/2/3);
# the camera must run on Orin1. SSH: ssh nvidia@192.168.41.2 (password: nvidia).
scp ubt_IL/scripts/deploy/tienkung_pro/image_server.py nvidia@192.168.41.2:~
ssh nvidia@192.168.41.2 'python3 image_server.py'
python3 /ubt_IL/scripts/deploy/tienkung_pro/image_client.py --server 192.168.41.2   # test camera path (127.0.0.1 is the simulator default)

# If the pyorbbec camera driver is not installed on the robot, install the dependencies
python3 -m pip install evdev
python3 -m pip install pyorbbecsdk2

docs.title: Deployment inference:
docs.text:
Script: /ubt_IL/scripts/deploy/tienkung_pro/rollout.sh

# 1. Initialize the pose (raise the arm above the table) -- inference container; /usr/bin/python3 has ROS access
/usr/bin/python3 /ubt_IL/scripts/deploy/tienkung_pro/reset.py

# 2. Real deployment: set ZMQ_HOST to the robot address (rollout.sh defaults to the simulator 127.0.0.1)
POLICY_PATH=/ubt_IL/model/tienkung_pick_up_act/checkpoints/100000/pretrained_model \
JOINT_CONFIG=tienkung_26 \
ZMQ_HOST=192.168.41.2 \
TASK="pick and place" \
FPS=15 \
DURATION=60 \
bash /ubt_IL/scripts/deploy/tienkung_pro/rollout.sh

# (Optional) Replay dataset actions on hardware
/usr/bin/python3 /ubt_IL/scripts/deploy/tienkung_pro/replay.py \
  --dataset /ubt_IL/dataset/tienkung_pick_up_merged --episode 0 --rate 30

Environment variables:

Variable Recommended for hardware Description POLICY_PATH /ubt_IL/model/tienkung_pick_up_act/checkpoints/last/pretrained_model Trained ACT checkpoint JOINT_CONFIG tienkung_26 26D; use tienkung_13 for 13D models, matching the training DOF STRATEGY base Autonomous execution ZMQ_HOST 192.168.41.2 Robot address (the script defaults to the simulator 127.0.0.1; hardware must override it) FPS 15 Control rate (aligned with training fps) DURATION 60 Run time (seconds) TASK pick and place Task description

Demo (real-robot deployment):

docs.title: Option B: on-robot Jetson AGX Orin
docs.text:
Scripts: /ubt_IL/scripts/deploy/tienkung_pro/arm_64/ (self-contained bundle; see ARM board deployment)

Target: Jetson AGX Orin (192.168.41.2). A conda env env_vla (Python 3.12) runs LeRobot, and system Python 3.10 runs the camera/ROS 2 side; the two are decoupled over ZMQ.

# 0. Environment setup
ssh nvidia@192.168.41.2   # password: nvidia
mkdir /home/nvidia/vla/   # create the working directory
# Copy the project code here
scp *project code* nvidia@192.168.41.2:/home/nvidia/vla/
# Build the conda env env_vla
cd /home/nvidia/vla/Thinker-IL-LAB/ubt_IL/scripts/deploy/tienkung_pro/arm_64
bash setup_env.sh

# 1. Start the camera service on the robot (real deployment only)
conda activate env_vla
bash /home/nvidia/vla/Thinker-IL-LAB/ubt_IL/scripts/deploy/tienkung_pro/arm_64/image_server_host.sh

# If the pyorbbec camera driver is not installed on the robot (install once)
python3 -m pip install evdev
python3 -m pip install pyorbbecsdk2

# (Optional) Camera preview test
bash /home/nvidia/vla/Thinker-IL-LAB/ubt_IL/scripts/deploy/tienkung_pro/arm_64/image_client_host.sh --show

# 2. Robot ready pose (raise the right arm)
bash /home/nvidia/vla/Thinker-IL-LAB/ubt_IL/scripts/deploy/tienkung_pro/arm_64/robot_ready.sh

# 3. Run inference
conda activate env_vla
# Deploy the 26-DOF model (default)
POLICY_PATH=/home/nvidia/vla/Thinker-IL-LAB/ubt_IL/model/tienkung_pick_up_act/checkpoints/100000/pretrained_model  DURATION=60 bash /home/nvidia/vla/Thinker-IL-LAB/ubt_IL/scripts/deploy/tienkung_pro/arm_64/rollout_host.sh

# 4. (Optional) Replay recorded actions on hardware
/usr/bin/python3 /home/nvidia/vla/Thinker-IL-LAB/ubt_IL/scripts/deploy/tienkung_pro/replay.py --dataset /home/nvidia/vla/Thinker-IL-LAB/ubt_IL/dataset/tienkung_pick_up_the_apple_all --episode 0 --rate 30

docs.title: Key parameters
docs.text: Variable Default Description POLICY_PATH $PROJECT_ROOT/model/tienkung_pick_up_act/checkpoints/last/pretrained_model ACT checkpoint JOINT_CONFIG tienkung_26 Joint DOF config (tienkung_26 = full 26; tienkung_13 = right arm 7 + right hand 6); custom configs are supported and must match the training DOF STRATEGY base Inference strategy (base autonomous; sentry/highlight/dagger for recording or interaction) TASK sim_pick_place Task description (injected as the policy condition) ZMQ_HOST 127.0.0.1 image_server address (change to the robot IP when the camera runs there) DURATION 60 Run time (seconds) FPS 30 Control loop rate (aligned with training fps) DISPLAY_CAM true Camera display (set false for SSH without X)

docs.title: 7. FAQ
docs.text: Symptom Possible cause / fix Conversion reports a missing depth stream Real HDF5 has no depth; use tienkung_pro_26d_1RGB_real.json (RGB only). Using the sim config reports a missing camera_head_depth Action dimensions are wrong after conversion The real master gripper is mapped to 6D via invert/repeat/pad; confirm the real config was used, not the sim config Normalization explodes during training (QUANTILES NaN/Inf) Constant dimensions (e.g. the commanded-but-frozen left arm in 26D) give std=0 and division by zero; convert with the 13D config (tienkung_pro_13d_1RGB.json) to drop dead dimensions Long stationary segments (prefix/tail) Stationary frames trap the policy; add TRIM_STATIONARY=1 during conversion Training raises FileExistsError OUTPUT_DIR already exists with RESUME=false; use a new directory or delete the old one Real deployment does not respond Is ZMQ_HOST pointing to the robot 192.168.41.2 (script default 127.0.0.1)? Is Bridge2 running (pgrep -f ros2_deploy_bridge)? Is the robot control board powered and networked? Real deployment motion is wrong JOINT_CONFIG does not match the training DOF (26D ↔ 13D); camera path unverified (run image_client.py first) Real deployment motion stops The policy may be stuck in a local loop; improve the dataset to reduce pauses Jetson inference crashes (numpy) numpy was upgraded to 2.x; rerun setup_env.sh and keep numpy==1.26.4 conda activate fails on Jetson In non-interactive shells, run source $CONDA_BASE/etc/profile.d/conda.sh before activating (the scripts handle this)

docs.title: Walker TienKung Pro: Simulation Platform
docs.text: The Walker TienKung Pro simulation is built on NVIDIA Isaac Sim (Isaac Lab 2.2.0). A ROS2-ZMQ bridge publishes simulation state and images on exactly the same ROS 2 topics as the real robot, enabling sim-to-real consistent teleoperation and data collection. The whole environment runs in a Docker container.

docs.title: Quick start
docs.text: Commands are split into two parts: build/enter the container on the host; launch simulation and collect data inside the container (container root is /ubt_sim).

docs.title: 1. Build and start the container (host)
docs.text:
See Simulation Platform · Container Setup for build / start / init / check / bash.

⚠️ Must be changed before building: edit interfaceWhiteList in ubt_sim/docker/fastdds_no_shm.xml and set <address> to 192.168.41.99 (the TienKung direct-link subnet). The file is copied into the image at build time; changes after the build have no effect.

docs.title: 2. Launch simulation (container)
docs.text:
bash run.sh bash                       # enter the container (ROS 2 environment sourced automatically)
bash /ubt_sim/scripts/start_sim.sh     # launch simulation and start the ROS2-ZMQ bridge automatically
  • The simulation loads UBTSim-TienkungPro-Parlor-v0 (parlor apple picking).
  • Press R to reset the robot (1 s debounce).
  • When the simulation window closes, the exit trap in start_sim.sh stops the bridge automatically.

Demo (pick-and-place task):

Common environment variables/arguments (combinable):

Variable Purpose Default UBT_SIM_TASK Task name (also determines the robot type) UBTSim-TienkungPro-Parlor-v0 --headless Run without a window Common on headless servers --perf_stats Print performance statistics Frame-rate debugging --device cpu\|cuda\|cuda:N Execution device For switching GPUs outside load-only mode

docs.title: 3. Data collection (container, system Python 3.10)
docs.text:
/usr/bin/python3 /ubt_sim/teleoperation/control/tienkung_pro/reset.py                  # reset the robot to zero
/usr/bin/python3 /ubt_sim/teleoperation/control/tienkung_pro/pick_place_save_data.py   # one pick-and-place + recording
bash /ubt_sim/teleoperation/control/tienkung_pro/save_data.sh                # batch loop (400 iterations by default)
  • reset.py: resets the robot pose only.
  • pick_place_save_data.py: performs one complete pick-and-place (random apple position → grasp → place → return) and records both arms/hands, actions, head RGB+depth images, and timestamps at 15 Hz. It saves only when the task succeeds (apple in the plate, distance < 0.12 m); failed episodes are discarded with exit code 1.
  • save_data.sh: calls pick_place_save_data.py in a loop for batch collection.
  • Output: /ubt_sim/dataset/tienkung_pro/<timestamp>/trajectory.hdf5.
  • Use --headless during collection to increase rendering speed and improve dataset throughput.

docs.title: 4. Camera test (container)
docs.text:
# Test the direct camera stream
python3 /ubt_sim/teleoperation/image/image_client.py
# Test the ROS 2 image path and save 3 JPEGs
/usr/bin/python3 /ubt_sim/teleoperation/image/test_ros_image.py

The direct JPEG stream from simulation (127.0.0.1:5558, published by the simulation process without the bridge) opens a window showing the head camera and prints latency/drop statistics. Simulation must already be running.

docs.title: 5. Dataset preview and playback (container)
docs.text:
Reads dataset/tienkung_pro/<timestamp>/trajectory.hdf5, previews cameras + joint curves (Rerun), or replays recorded actions on simulation/hardware topics.

# Preview an HDF5 episode
/usr/bin/python3 /ubt_sim/teleoperation/tools/playback_tienkung_pro.py \
    --episode dataset/tienkung_pro/1786638182 --mode preview --web-port 9090

# Action playback (simulation/hardware)
/usr/bin/python3 /ubt_sim/teleoperation/tools/playback_tienkung_pro.py \
    --episode dataset/tienkung_pro/1786638182 --mode control

See Playback for all options and safety notes.

docs.title: Simulation modules
docs.text: Module Path Description Docker orchestration ubt_sim/docker/run.sh Image build, container lifecycle, bridge start/stop Environment variables ubt_sim/docker/env.sh Container name, image, ROS_DOMAIN_ID Simulation launcher ubt_sim/scripts/start_sim.sh Detects the robot, starts the bridge, launches sim_runner.py Task definition ubt_sim/source/ubt_sim/task/tienkung_pro_parlor/ Parlor apple-picking scene and rewards Runtime config ubt_sim/config/tienkung_pro/parlor.yaml Scene/camera/device parameters ROS2-ZMQ bridge ubt_sim/teleoperation/bridges/tienkung_pro/ Bridge script + bridge_config.yaml Teleoperation and collection ubt_sim/teleoperation/control/tienkung_pro/ reset.py / pick_place_save_data.py / save_data.sh Camera client ubt_sim/teleoperation/image/image_client.py Direct JPEG stream (5558) debugging Data output ubt_sim/dataset/tienkung_pro/<timestamp>/trajectory.hdf5 Collected episodes

docs.title: ZMQ ports
docs.text:
Port Purpose 5555 Control commands (bridge PUB) 5556 Robot state (bridge SUB) 5557 Raw camera images (C++ bridge) 5558 Direct JPEG (published by simulation, no bridge)

See Architecture · ZMQ ports for the cross-robot overview.

docs.title: Troubleshooting
docs.text:
• bash run.sh check reports errors: follow the prompt and rerun bash run.sh init; verify numpy<2, bodyctrl_msgs, and the Walker SDK ROS 2 message packages.
  • Collection script fails to import rclpy / message types: use /usr/bin/python3, not Isaac Sim Python, and confirm bash run.sh init built the message packages.
  • save_data.sh trips the consecutive-failure breaker: usually the bridge is not ready. Verify the simulation window is running and the bridge process exists (pgrep -f tienkung_pro_ros2_zmq_bridge), or run bash run.sh bridge-start separately.
  • X11 unavailable / no simulation window: run xhost + on the host and verify DISPLAY is forwarded; on headless machines only UBT_SIM_LOAD_ONLY=1 preview is available.

After collection, continue with Imitation Learning Platform.

docs.title: Walker TienKung Pro Simulation Workflow: Collect -> Convert -> Train -> Evaluate -> Deploy
docs.text:
Robot: Walker TienKung Pro Data source: Isaac Sim collection (ubt_sim) Container: lerobot-tienkung (built/started by docker/run.sh, project mounted at /ubt_IL)

This guide covers the complete, reproducible workflow from raw simulation HDF5 to a LeRobot dataset, ACT training, offline evaluation, and finally simulator deployment. All conversion/training/evaluation/deployment scripts run inside the ubt_IL container.

docs.title: Contents
docs.text:
• 0. Workflow overview
  • 1. Prerequisite: simulation collection (ubt_sim)
  • 2. Start the container (ubt_IL)
  • 3. Data conversion (HDF5 -> LeRobot)
  • 3.1 Conversion command
  • 3.2 Data visualization
  • 4. Policy training
  • 5. Policy evaluation (offline MSE)
  • 6. Model deployment (simulation)
  • 7. FAQ

docs.title: 0. Workflow overview
docs.text: Simulation collection (hdf5) --> Data conversion (LeRobot dataset) --> Model training [train.sh ACT] --> Policy evaluation [eval_policy.py] --> Model deployment [rollout.sh feedback] --> Simulator deployment [Isaac Sim]

docs.title: 1. Prerequisite: simulation collection (ubt_sim)
docs.text:
Simulation HDF5 data is collected by ubt_sim (see Simulation Platform). Key points:

# ① Inside the ubt_sim container, start simulation (starts the ROS2-ZMQ bridge automatically)
bash /ubt_sim/scripts/start_sim.sh          # add --headless to speed up collection

# ② Collect data (system Python 3.10)
/usr/bin/python3 /ubt_sim/teleoperation/control/tienkung_pro/reset.py                  # reset
bash /ubt_sim/teleoperation/control/tienkung_pro/save_data.sh                          # batch loop (400 iterations by default)
  • An episode is saved only after a successful pick-and-place (apple in the plate, distance < 0.12 m); failures are discarded with exit code 1.
  • Output: /ubt_sim/dataset/tienkung_pro/<timestamp>/trajectory.hdf5.

After collection, place the HDF5 data where the container can access it (e.g. /ubt_IL/dataset/tienkung_pro/, the default SRC_ROOT in section 3), then proceed to conversion.

docs.title: 2. Start the container (ubt_IL)
docs.text:
cd ubt_IL/docker
bash run.sh build      # first time
bash run.sh start
bash run.sh bash       # enter the container; run the remaining commands there

docs.title: 3.1 Conversion command
docs.text:
Script: /ubt_IL/scripts/convert/tienkung_pro/convert.sh Configs: /ubt_IL/scripts/convert/tienkung_pro/configs/, including field filtering and mapping; choose or adapt one for your training needs.

# Simulation conversion
CONFIG=/ubt_IL/scripts/convert/tienkung_pro/configs/Tien_Kung_13_1RGB_sim.json \
SRC_ROOT=/ubt_IL/dataset/tienkung_pro \
TGT_PATH=/ubt_IL/dataset \
REPO_ID=tienkung_sim_pick_place \
TASK_NAME=tienkung_sim_pick_place \
bash /ubt_IL/scripts/convert/tienkung_pro/convert.sh

# Stationary frames can trap the policy in a local stationary loop; enable trimming with TRIM_STATIONARY=1
TRIM_STATIONARY=1 \
CONFIG=/ubt_IL/scripts/convert/tienkung_pro/configs/Tien_Kung_13_1RGB_sim.json \
SRC_ROOT=/ubt_IL/dataset/tienkung_pro \
TGT_PATH=/ubt_IL/dataset \
REPO_ID=tienkung_sim_pick_place \
TASK_NAME=tienkung_sim_pick_place \
bash /ubt_IL/scripts/convert/tienkung_pro/convert.sh

Environment variables (defaults can be omitted; see bash convert.sh -h for the rest):

Variable Recommended for simulation Description SRC_ROOT /ubt_IL/dataset/tienkung_pro (default) Simulation HDF5 root (one subdirectory per episode containing trajectory.hdf5) TGT_PATH /ubt_IL/dataset (default) LeRobot output root CONFIG configs/Tien_Kung_13_1RGB_sim.json 13D single arm + single hand, one RGB; use tienkung_pro_26d_1RGB.json for dual-arm 26D REPO_ID tienkung_sim_pick_place Output dataset name (keep it consistent with training) FPS 15 Target frame rate ROBOT_TYPE tienkung Robot type TASK_NAME tienkung_sim_pick_place Task name (written to each frame's task field and used as the language condition) VCODEC h264 Video codec HDF5_REL_PATH trajectory.hdf5 (default) HDF5 path relative to each episode directory TRIM_STATIONARY Empty (off) / 1 Stationary-frame trimming: truncate runs longer than the cap (default 8 frames) STATIONARY_DIAGNOSE Empty / 1 Only report the stationary distribution without writing data (for threshold calibration) RESAMPLE_FPS Empty (no resampling) Target frame rate; enables resampling

Output: a LeRobot v3 dataset under /ubt_IL/dataset/<REPO_ID>/ (meta/, chunk-000/ data parquet, videos/).

docs.title: 3.2 Data visualization
docs.text:
Use lerobot-dataset-viz inside the container to inspect the converted dataset. Checking data before training is important to avoid training blindly:

# Inside the container:
HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 lerobot-dataset-viz \
  --repo-id <dataset name> \
  --episode-index 0 \
  --root /ubt_IL/dataset/<dataset name>

Example:

# Visualize the dataset converted in section 3.1
HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 lerobot-dataset-viz \
  --repo-id tienkung_sim_pick_place \
  --episode-index 0 \
  --root /ubt_IL/dataset/tienkung_sim_pick_place

Note: --root must point to the dataset directory containing meta/ (the repo_id directory itself), not its parent. HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 disables access to the HuggingFace Hub.

docs.title: 4. Policy training
docs.text:
Training script: /ubt_IL/scripts/train/tienkung_pro/train.sh Configs: /ubt_IL/scripts/train/tienkung_pro/configs/; choose or adapt one for your training needs.

# Train with the default config
bash /ubt_IL/scripts/train/tienkung_pro/train.sh

# Specify a config path explicitly and override common parameters
CONFIG_PATH=/ubt_IL/scripts/train/tienkung_pro/configs/train_config_tienkung_pro_sim_pick_place.json \
OUTPUT_DIR=/ubt_IL/model/tienkung_sim_pick_place_act \
STEPS=80000 SAVE_FREQ=20000 BATCH_SIZE=8 \
bash /ubt_IL/scripts/train/tienkung_pro/train.sh

# Resume (CONFIG_PATH points to train_config.json inside the checkpoint)
CONFIG_PATH=/ubt_IL/model/tienkung_sim_pick_place_act/checkpoints/last/pretrained_model/train_config.json \
RESUME=true \
bash /ubt_IL/scripts/train/tienkung_pro/train.sh

Without train.sh (call lerobot-train directly and use --xxx=yyy overrides; run from /ubt_IL/lerobot):

# Train from scratch
cd /ubt_IL/lerobot
HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 /lerobot/.venv/bin/lerobot-train \
  --config_path=/ubt_IL/scripts/train/tienkung_pro/configs/train_config_tienkung_pro_sim_pick_place.json \
  --output_dir=/ubt_IL/model/tienkung_sim_pick_place_act \
  --steps=80000 --save_freq=20000 --batch_size=8

# Resume
HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 /lerobot/.venv/bin/lerobot-train \
  --config_path=/ubt_IL/model/tienkung_sim_pick_place_act/checkpoints/last/pretrained_model/train_config.json \
  --resume=true

Common overrides (environment variables for train.sh; unset values come from the config file):

Variable Config default Description CONFIG_PATH configs/train_config_tienkung_pro_sim_pick_place.json Training config JSON (the train.sh default) DATASET_REPO_ID / DATASET_ROOT tienkung_sim_pick_place / /ubt_IL/dataset/tienkung_sim_pick_place Dataset name / root (must match the conversion REPO_ID in section 3) OUTPUT_DIR /ubt_IL/model/tienkung_sim_pick_place_act Model output directory (checkpoints under checkpoints/last/pretrained_model/) STEPS 50000 Training steps SAVE_FREQ 10000 Checkpoint save interval (steps) BATCH_SIZE 16 Batch size RESUME false Resume training (true makes CONFIG_PATH point to train_config.json inside the checkpoint)

docs.title: 5. Policy evaluation (offline MSE)
docs.text:
Script: /ubt_IL/scripts/eval/eval_policy.py. It runs offline inference over a LeRobot dataset, computes the per-frame MSE between predicted and ground-truth actions, and can plot per-episode comparisons. Quantify policy quality before deployment.

# Inside the container (LeRobot venv Python)
/lerobot/.venv/bin/python /ubt_IL/scripts/eval/eval_policy.py \
  --policy-path /ubt_IL/model/tienkung_sim_pick_place_right13_act/checkpoints/last/pretrained_model \
  --dataset-path /ubt_IL/dataset/tienkung_sim_pick_place \
  --episodes 5 \
  --inference-freq 1 \
  --plot \
  --plot-dir /ubt_IL/scripts/eval/output/eval_tienkung_sim_pick_place_right13_act \
  --output /ubt_IL/scripts/eval/output/eval_tienkung_sim_pick_place_right13_act/results.json \
  --device cuda

Example output (per-episode prediction vs ground truth):

Main arguments:

Argument Description --policy-path Trained ACT checkpoint (the pretrained_model directory) --dataset-path LeRobot dataset root (containing meta/info.json) --episodes Number of episodes to evaluate (default: all) --inference-freq Run inference every N steps to emulate the deployment chunk queue; defaults to policy.n_action_steps; 1 means every step --plot / --plot-dir Per-episode prediction-vs-ground-truth plots (PNG) --output Result JSON (summary + per-episode MSE) --device cuda (default; falls back to cpu when unavailable)

Output: the console prints Mean/Std/Min/Max MSE and per-joint MSE; --output saves the result JSON and --plot saves comparison plots.

docs.title: 6. Model deployment (simulation)
docs.text:
Script: /ubt_IL/scripts/deploy/tienkung_pro/rollout.sh. Simulation deployment uses the ubt_sim module instead of the real robot. It exposes the same ROS topics and communication method as hardware, so it validates the policy before real deployment and avoids damage from incorrect motions. The simulation container runs independently and communicates with the training/inference container over the local loopback 127.0.0.1. See Simulation Platform for simulation usage.

Deployment steps (run in the simulation and inference containers separately):

# 1. Start simulation (skip if already running) -- host, enter the simulation container
cd ubt_sim/docker 
bash run.sh start
bash run.sh bash
bash /ubt_sim/scripts/start_sim.sh      # inside the container: start simulation and the ROS2-ZMQ bridge

# 2. Start the inference container -- host
cd ubt_IL/docker
bash run.sh start
bash run.sh bash

# 3. Initialize the pose (raise the arm above the table) -- inference container; /usr/bin/python3 has ROS access
/usr/bin/python3 /ubt_IL/scripts/deploy/tienkung_pro/reset.py

# Deploy the 13-DOF model (right arm 7 + right hand 6, matching the conversion config)
POLICY_PATH=/ubt_IL/model/tienkung_sim_pick_place_right13_act/checkpoints/last/pretrained_model \
  JOINT_CONFIG=tienkung_13 bash /ubt_IL/scripts/deploy/tienkung_pro/rollout.sh

# (Optional) Verify the camera path
python /ubt_IL/scripts/deploy/tienkung_pro/image_client.py --count 60

# (Optional) Replay dataset actions in simulation
/usr/bin/python3 /ubt_IL/scripts/deploy/tienkung_pro/replay.py \
  --dataset /ubt_IL/dataset/tienkung_sim_pick_place --episode 0 --rate 30

Environment variables:

Variable Recommended for simulation Description POLICY_PATH /ubt_IL/model/tienkung_sim_pick_place_act/checkpoints/last/pretrained_model Trained ACT checkpoint JOINT_CONFIG tienkung_26 26D; use tienkung_13 for 13D models, matching the training DOF STRATEGY base Autonomous execution ZMQ_HOST 127.0.0.1 Simulator address (hardware uses 192.168.41.2) FPS 15 Control rate (aligned with training fps) DURATION 60 Run time (seconds) TASK sim pick and place Task description

After deployment, watch the simulated robot execute the pick-and-place policy; use reset.py to reset and replay.py to validate playback.

Demo:

docs.title: 7. FAQ
docs.text: Stage Symptom Possible cause / fix Collection Many duplicate frames, low frame rate Reduce the number of rendered cameras, use headless collection, or use a high-performance multi-GPU machine Collection Normalization explodes during training (QUANTILES NaN/Inf) Constant dimensions: the left arm is commanded-but-frozen in 26D and the left gripper is always 1.0, so std=0 causes division by zero. Convert with the 13D single-arm config (Tien_Kung_13_1RGB_sim.json) to drop dead dimensions Collection Long stationary segments (prefix/tail) Stationary frames trap the policy; add TRIM_STATIONARY=1 during conversion Conversion FileNotFoundError (HDF5) Wrong SRC_ROOT; make sure HDF5 was synced from ubt_sim to a container-accessible directory Training Occasional non-convergence Insufficient simulation data; increase save_data.sh iterations; confirm image_transforms is enabled for generalization Deployment No camera image Simulator not running / camera stream not started; verify the 5558 path with image_client.py Deployment Motion stutters Try asynchronous inference with RTC trajectory blending Deployment Motion stops The policy may be stuck in a local loop; improve the dataset to reduce pauses Deployment Simulator does not respond Check whether the bridge is running and whether loopback networking is connected

docs.title: Walker TienKung Dex
docs.text: Walker TienKung Dex is the single-arm dexterous manipulation variant of the TienKung series: a 7-DOF right arm plus a dexterous right hand, available with either the Inspire RH5DG2 (67 revolute joints) or BrainCo Revo2 (53 revolute joints) hand. The policy controls only the right arm and right hand; the left arm, waist, head, and legs are moved to the ready pose by robot_ready.sh and then held still.

docs.title: Specifications
docs.text:
Item Specification Configuration 7-DOF right arm + dexterous right hand (Inspire 13 channels / BrainCo 6 motors) Dexterous hand Inspire RH5DG2 (67 revolute) / BrainCo Revo2 (53 revolute) Common training dimensions 20D (right arm 7 + right hand 13, Inspire) / 13D (right arm 7 + right hand 6, BrainCo or Inspire r13) Joints not controlled by the policy Left arm / waist / head / legs (constant in the data; held at the ready pose) LeRobot plugin ubt_IL/tienkung_dex/lerobot_robot_tienkung_dex (robot type tienkung_dex, camera type dex_camera) USD model ubt_sim/assets/robots/tienkung_dex/usd/tienkung_dex_inspire.usd / tienkung_dex_brainco.usd Camera Head-mounted monocular RGB: /ob_camera_head/color/image_raw Training resolution Simulation / BrainCo real: 640×360 RGB; Inspire r13 real config: 1280×720 ROS domain ROS_DOMAIN_ID=0 by default (same domain as the real robot; set 146 on both sides to isolate)

✅ Verified on hardware (Nov 2026): the full real-robot training and deployment loop has been validated with both Inspire and BrainCo hands. Verified dataset: tienkung_dex_real_pick_apple_brainco_13d (32 episodes / 16,956 frames / 30 fps, 13D = right arm 7 + BrainCo hand 6).

docs.title: Action space (three JOINT_CONFIG variants)
docs.text: JOINT_CONFIG Dimension Hand Policy-side hand representation tienkung_dex_20 20D = right arm 7 + right hand 13 Inspire 13 joint angles in rad tienkung_dex_brainco_13 13D = right arm 7 + right hand 6 BrainCo 6 closure values in 0~1 tienkung_dex_inspire_13 13D = right arm 7 + right hand 6 Inspire 6 normalized values in 0~1, expanded by Bridge2 into 13 angle codes

Platform entry points (shared architecture and commands are on the platform overview pages):

  • Imitation Learning Platform · Walker TienKung Dex - HDF5 -> LeRobot conversion, ACT training, offline evaluation, deployment parameters

docs.title: Walker TienKung Dex: On-Robot Deployment (Thor / Jazzy, No Container)
docs.text:
This page explains how to run the policy directly on the robot's ARM board (NVIDIA Thor, Ubuntu 24.04 + ROS 2 Jazzy + Python 3.12) without Docker. Data conversion and training are still recommended on a workstation/container; the robot only performs deployment.

Scripts: ubt_IL/scripts/deploy/tienkung_dex/arm_64/.

docs.title: 1. Runtime architecture (dual Python stacks, ZMQ decoupling)
docs.text:
Layer A  $VENV (3.12): lerobot-rollout / lerobot-train
        │ 5559 actions ▼        ▲ 5560 state       ▲ 5558 JPEG (640×360)
Layer B  system python3 (3.12) + Jazzy: ros2_deploy_bridge.py
        │ /arm/cmd, /right_hand/set_motor_multi          ▲ /robot_state (≈200Hz)
        └ /ob_camera_head/color/image_raw (1280×720 → resize 640×360 → JPEG)
Layer C  system python3 + Jazzy: robot_ready.py (ready pose, mutually exclusive with layer B)
Layer Interpreter Runs Ports / topics A $PROJECT_ROOT/.venv-dex (3.12) lerobot-rollout / lerobot-train 5559 actions / 5560 state B /usr/bin/python3 + Jazzy ros2_deploy_bridge.py 5558 JPEG, /arm/cmd, hand commands C /usr/bin/python3 + Jazzy robot_ready.py (mutually exclusive with layer B) /arm/cmd

docs.title: 2. Why not Docker / conda
docs.text: Option Verdict docker The repository's Dockerfile.arm64 targets JetPack6 / 22.04 / Humble / Orin sm_87, which is incompatible with Thor (JetPack7 / 24.04 / Jazzy / sm_110); the current user is also not in the docker group and has no passwordless sudo conda The host torch comes from a deleted local wheel; PyPI aarch64 torch has no CUDA; the jetson-ai-lab jp7/cu130 index has no cp312 wheel → no usable torch venv(--system-site-packages) Inherits the host sm_110 torch directly; tested with numpy 2.2.6 and torch/torchvision/cv2 all work (the Orin numpy<2 pitfall does not exist here)

docs.title: 3. Files
docs.text: File Purpose env.sh Shared constants (PROJECT_ROOT/VENV/BRIDGE_SCRIPT) + dex_source_ros (explicitly sources Jazzy) setup_env.sh Creates the venv, installs LeRobot/plugins (--no-deps to keep torch), self-checks the 13D contract robot_ready_host.sh Ready pose (system python + Jazzy) rollout_host.sh Policy inference (venv), with dimension precheck bridge_smoke.sh Read-only smoke test: verifies state/image/e-stop links without moving the robot camera_preview.sh Head camera preview: live window / --snapshot / --size raw for 720p hold_test.py Zero-displacement control-path acceptance (target = current measured angles, no motion) staged_test.sh Staged micro-motion: head / hand / arm ±0.05 rad (hand 80 codes) out and back, with measured verification robot_home_host.sh Return to standing: reverses the four ready-pose waypoints (hands stay above the table), target HOME_POSE + real-robot offsets

docs.title: 4. Environment setup (first time)
docs.text:
The repository (including the lerobot submodule) must be synced to the robot — PROJECT_ROOT is derived from the script location as ubt_IL/ inside the repository. LFS assets (ubt_sim simulation resources) are not needed.

Prechecks:

python3 -V                                   # 3.12
ls /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash
/usr/bin/python3 -c "import rclpy, ros2_bridge_msgs, bodyctrl_msgs, inspire_hand_msgs, brainco_hand_msgs"
/usr/bin/python3 -c "import torch; print(torch.__version__, torch.cuda.is_available(), torch.cuda.get_arch_list())"

Vendor message packages are installed system-wide by default; if they live in a custom workspace, set TIENKUNG_DEX_MSGS_WS=<ws> (default /opt/tienkung_dex_msgs_ws). ROS_SETUP can explicitly select the ROS distribution; by default it checks /opt/ros/jazzy then /opt/ros/humble.

Create the environment:

cd ubt_IL/scripts/deploy/tienkung_dex/arm_64
bash setup_env.sh

setup_env.sh is idempotent (reruns skip venv creation and dependency reinstallation). It performs:

Step Description venv python3 -m venv --system-site-packages $PROJECT_ROOT/.venv-dex; does not install torch, inheriting the host sm_110 build numpy Installs numpy==2.2.6 (LeRobot requires >=2.0,<2.3) Runtime dependencies draccus / gymnasium / einops / safetensors / huggingface-hub / datasets / av / pyzmq, etc.; does not install opencv (uses the host cv2 with GUI support) numpy2-ABI packages pandas / pyarrow / matplotlib / scikit-learn use --ignore-installed, otherwise numpy1-built packages in host ~/.local raise numpy.dtype size changed Editable install --no-deps -e lerobot + -e tienkung_dex (--no-deps prevents pip from replacing torch with the PyPI CPU build) Self-check torch CUDA / sm_110, numpy version, the dimensions and hand contract of all three JOINT_CONFIG values, lerobot-rollout --help

On success you should see cuda=True, archs containing sm_110, numpy 2.2.6, and:

joint_config=tienkung_dex_brainco_13  dim=13 hand=brainco mode=rad13 ...
joint_config=tienkung_dex_20          dim=20 hand=inspire  mode=rad13 ...
joint_config=tienkung_dex_inspire_13  dim=13 hand=inspire  mode=pico6 ...
dex_camera registered | 13D contract: ...
[setup] lerobot-rollout OK
[setup] done.

Failures usually fall into two cases: cuda=False means the venv did not inherit the host torch; numpy.dtype size changed means the ABI packages were not installed into the venv (rerun setup_env.sh).

docs.title: 5. First integration (without the policy)
docs.text:
cd ubt_IL/scripts/deploy/tienkung_dex/arm_64

bash bridge_smoke.sh                     # read-only check: status ≥30 Hz, image ≥10 fps, estop=false
bash camera_preview.sh --snapshot        # capture the policy view (/tmp/dex_camera_preview.png)
source ./env.sh && dex_source_ros        # layer B uses system python + Jazzy
/usr/bin/python3 hold_test.py --groups arm   # zero-displacement path acceptance
bash staged_test.sh --step all           # head/hand/arm micro-motion and return, verify direction
bash robot_ready_host.sh --dry-run       # inspect the four targets first
bash robot_ready_host.sh --real          # send the ready pose (operator at the e-stop)

For the Inspire r13 path: HAND_VARIANT=inspire HAND_ACTION_MODE=pico6 bash bridge_smoke.sh (the right_hand in state should be 6D). camera_preview.sh starts its own subscribe-only Bridge2; --size raw shows native 1280×720, and --port 5558 connects to an existing bridge.

docs.title: 6. Deployment inference
docs.text:
POLICY_PATH=/abs/path/pretrained_model \
JOINT_CONFIG=tienkung_dex_brainco_13 \
CAMERA_PORT=5558 IMAGE_ENABLED=1 FPS=30 \
DURATION=10 MAX_RELATIVE_TARGET=0.01 \
bash rollout_host.sh
Variable Default Description POLICY_PATH None (required) Checkpoint pretrained_model directory JOINT_CONFIG tienkung_dex_brainco_13 BrainCo 6 motors; use tienkung_dex_20 for Inspire 20D; tienkung_dex_inspire_13 for Inspire r13 datasets HAND_ACTION_MODE Empty (auto) Empty derives from JOINT_CONFIG; tienkung_dex_inspire_13 → pico6 FPS 15 Must equal the dataset frame rate CAMERA_PORT / IMAGE_ENABLED 5558 / 1 Real robot uses Bridge2 transcoding CAMERA_WIDTH/HEIGHT 640×360 Used for both Bridge2 resizing and the dex_camera crop window MAX_RELATIVE_TARGET Empty 0.01 (rad/step) for the first run DISPLAY_CAM true Set false when there is no X server (SSH)

docs.title: 7. Comparison with the container version
docs.text: Container version On-robot version Notes robot_ready.sh --real robot_ready_host.sh --real System python3 + Jazzy rollout.sh rollout_host.sh Runs in the venv and starts Bridge2 automatically preview_camera.py camera_preview.sh Bridge2 transcodes directly on the robot inference_server.sh Not available The warm-started inference service still requires the container version

docs.title: 8. Notes and troubleshooting
docs.text:
• Camera size mismatch does not raise an error: feeding 720p unchanged makes dex_camera slice columns by offset_x+width and take the "left half"; the policy still outputs, but the visual distribution is completely wrong. Bridge2's image_width/image_height now resize before encoding; always run camera_preview.sh --snapshot first to confirm the full view.
  • bash -lc does not source .bashrc: Bridge2 inherits the ROS environment from its parent process; scripts explicitly source Jazzy via dex_source_ros. Source it manually when starting the bridge by hand.
  • /arm/cmd has no consumer: the robot must be in topic-control mode (remote half-body policy toggled up), otherwise "the policy runs but the robot does not move".
  • robot_ready and Bridge2 are mutually exclusive: both write /arm/cmd; the order is always ready first, then rollout.
  • Emergency stop: Bridge2 monitors is_estop on /power/board/key_status; previously sent targets remain in the drives, so press the physical e-stop if necessary.
  • wrist_roll_l 40 Hz friction limit cycle: the real-robot home/ready pose already adds +0.03 rad via constants.DEPLOY_HOME_OFFSETS; if the right wrist buzzes after swapping robots, add an entry to that table.
  • cuda=False: the venv did not inherit the host torch; confirm python3 -m venv --system-site-packages created $PROJECT_ROOT/.venv-dex.
  • numpy.dtype size changed: ABI packages were not installed into the venv; rerun setup_env.sh.

See ubt_IL/scripts/deploy/tienkung_dex/arm_64/README.md in the repository for the full file list and field measurements.

docs.title: Walker TienKung Dex: Imitation Learning Platform
docs.text:
Code: ubt_IL/scripts/{convert,train,eval,deploy}/tienkung_dex/ (run inside the container) Prerequisite: repository cloned and submodules initialized as described in Getting Started; HDF5 data ready (simulation collection or real-robot collection)

This page documents the shared conversion/training/evaluation/deployment workflow and configuration parameters for Walker TienKung Dex. Data-source-specific commands are embedded in the corresponding workflow pages.

docs.title: 1. Environment (ubt_IL container)
docs.text:
See Imitation Learning Platform · Container Setup for build / start / bash.

  • The host project is mounted at /ubt_IL.
  • Communication: LeRobot (Python 3.12) —ZMQ 5559/5560—> Bridge2 (system Python 3.10) —ROS 2 DDS—> robot/simulator.
  • Camera stream: simulation uses 5758 (ubt_sim publishes JPEG directly); hardware uses 5558 (Bridge2 transcodes with --enable-image).
  • Dex message packages (ros2_bridge_msgs / inspire_hand_msgs / brainco_hand_msgs) are built into /opt/tienkung_dex_msgs_ws during the image build; the three tienkung_dex lines in bash run.sh check should all be [OK].
  • To run the policy on the robot itself (Thor, no container), skip this section and create the venv as described in On-robot deployment.

docs.title: 2. Data conversion (HDF5 -> LeRobot)
docs.text:
Script: /ubt_IL/scripts/convert/tienkung_dex/convert.sh (shared converter convert/common/convert_to_lerobot.py). It converts raw HDF5 into a LeRobot v3 dataset at /ubt_IL/dataset/<REPO_ID>/.

Conversion command:

CONFIG=/ubt_IL/scripts/convert/tienkung_dex/configs/tienkung_dex_20d_1RGB_inspire.json \
SRC_ROOT=/ubt_sim/dataset/tienkung_dex \
TGT_PATH=/ubt_IL/dataset \
REPO_ID=tienkung_dex_sim_pick_apple \
TASK_NAME=tienkung_dex_sim_pick_apple \
FPS=15 \
bash /ubt_IL/scripts/convert/tienkung_dex/convert.sh --overwrite

Examples:

  • Simulation data: Simulation workflow · Data conversion
  • Real-robot data: Real-robot workflow · Data conversion

Conversion configs in /ubt_IL/scripts/convert/tienkung_dex/configs/:

Config Dimension Hand / scenario Image tienkung_dex_20d_1RGB_inspire.json 20D (right arm 7 + right hand 13) Inspire, simulation (default) 3×360×640 tienkung_dex_13d_1RGB_brainco_real.json 13D (right arm 7 + right hand 6) BrainCo, real robot (verified) 3×360×640 tienkung_dex_real_pick_r13_1RGB.json 13D (right arm 7 + right hand 6) Inspire r13 real robot (pico6) 3×720×1280

Common environment variables (defaults can be omitted; see bash convert.sh -h and Data Conversion):

Variable Description SRC_ROOT HDF5 root (default /ubt_IL/dataset/tienkung_dex; falls back to /ubt_sim/dataset/tienkung_dex if absent) TGT_PATH LeRobot output root (default /ubt_IL/dataset) CONFIG Conversion config JSON (default tienkung_dex_20d_1RGB_inspire.json) REPO_ID Output dataset name (default tienkung_dex_sim_pick_apple; keep it consistent with training) TASK_NAME Task name (default tienkung_dex_sim_pick_apple, written to each frame's task field) FPS Target frame rate (simulation default 15; use FPS=30 for 30 fps real-robot data) ROBOT_TYPE Robot type (default tienkung_dex, written to metadata) VCODEC Video codec (default h264) HDF5_REL_PATH HDF5 path relative to each episode directory (default trajectory.hdf5) TRIM_STATIONARY 1 enables stationary-frame trimming (disabled by default) STATIONARY_DIAGNOSE 1 only reports the stationary distribution without writing data (for threshold calibration) STATIONARY_CAP / STATIONARY_THRESH Maximum stationary run (default 8 frames) / detection threshold (default 0.03) RESAMPLE_FPS Target frame rate; enables resampling when set (disabled by default)

Stationary-frame trimming

Stationary frames can trap the policy in a local stationary loop. Dex simulation data is not trimmed by default: run with STATIONARY_DIAGNOSE=1 first, then decide whether to set TRIM_STATIONARY=1. On 20 episodes with default parameters, trimming reduced 10,937 → 8,269 frames (-24.4%) while preserving the 20D ranges and the maximum per-frame step. Real-robot data can enable it as needed (removing long stationary ready-pose segments at the start and end).

State / action sources:

Field HDF5 source Columns observation.state joint_observations/joint_position + hand_observations/hand_right_position (measured values) [24..30] + all 13 right-hand columns action action_observations/joint_position + action_observations/hand_right_position (commanded values) Same

Do not swap them: action_* are the recorded commands, *_observations are measurements. Hand actions lead states by up to 1.31 rad, which matches the semantics of get_observation() during deployment.

Output: a LeRobot v3 dataset under /ubt_IL/dataset/<REPO_ID>/ (meta/, chunk-000/ data parquet, videos/).

docs.title: 3. Data visualization
docs.text:
After conversion, inspect dataset quality with lerobot-dataset-viz:

HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 lerobot-dataset-viz \
  --repo-id <REPO_ID> \
  --episode-index 0 \
  --root /ubt_IL/dataset/<REPO_ID>

--root must point to the dataset directory containing meta/ (the repo_id directory itself), not its parent. --episode-index is required and visualizes one episode at a time.

Examples: Simulation workflow · Visualization / Real-robot workflow · Evaluation.

docs.title: 4. Policy training (ACT)
docs.text:
Training script: /ubt_IL/scripts/train/tienkung_dex/train.sh; configs in /ubt_IL/scripts/train/tienkung_dex/configs/.

Training command (optional overrides are listed below; unset values come from the config file):

CONFIG_PATH=/ubt_IL/scripts/train/tienkung_dex/configs/train_config_tienkung_dex_sim_pick_apple.json \
OUTPUT_DIR=/ubt_IL/model/tienkung_dex_sim_pick_apple_act \
STEPS=60000 SAVE_FREQ=10000 BATCH_SIZE=16 \
bash /ubt_IL/scripts/train/tienkung_dex/train.sh

Training configs (ACT, chunk_size=50, n_action_steps=20, dim_model=512):

Config Dataset Steps / save interval Batch train_config_tienkung_dex_sim_pick_apple.json tienkung_dex_sim_pick_apple 60000 / 10000 16 train_config_tienkung_dex_real_pick_apple.json tienkung_dex_real_pick_apple 30000 / 5000 16 train_config_tienkung_dex_real_pick_apple_brainco_13d.json tienkung_dex_real_pick_apple_brainco_13d 20000 / 5000 16

⚠️ train.sh defaults CONFIG_PATH to the simulation config; real-robot training must specify the real config explicitly.

Smoke test and resume:

# Smoke test: 2 steps, no checkpoint
bash /ubt_IL/scripts/train/tienkung_dex/train.sh --steps=2 --save_checkpoint=false

# Resume (CONFIG_PATH points to train_config.json inside the checkpoint)
CONFIG_PATH=/ubt_IL/model/tienkung_dex_sim_pick_apple_act/checkpoints/last/pretrained_model/train_config.json \
RESUME=true bash /ubt_IL/scripts/train/tienkung_dex/train.sh

Without train.sh (call lerobot-train directly from /ubt_IL/lerobot):

cd /ubt_IL/lerobot
HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 /lerobot/.venv/bin/lerobot-train \
  --config_path=/ubt_IL/scripts/train/tienkung_dex/configs/train_config_tienkung_dex_sim_pick_apple.json \
  --output_dir=/ubt_IL/model/tienkung_dex_sim_pick_apple_act

Common overrides (only applied when the environment variable is set; HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 is enabled by default):

Variable Description CONFIG_PATH Training config JSON (default: simulation config) DATASET_REPO_ID / DATASET_ROOT Dataset name / root (must match the conversion REPO_ID) OUTPUT_DIR Model output directory (checkpoints under checkpoints/<step>/pretrained_model/) STEPS / SAVE_FREQ Training steps / checkpoint interval BATCH_SIZE / SEED Batch size / random seed DEVICE Training device (default cuda) RESUME Resume training (default false) WANDB_ENABLE Enable wandb logging (default false)

docs.title: 5. Policy evaluation (offline MSE)
docs.text:
Script (shared by all robots): /ubt_IL/scripts/eval/eval_policy.py. It runs offline inference over a LeRobot dataset, computes the per-frame MSE between predicted and ground-truth actions, and can plot per-episode comparisons.

Evaluation command:

/lerobot/.venv/bin/python /ubt_IL/scripts/eval/eval_policy.py \
  --policy-path /ubt_IL/model/tienkung_dex_sim_pick_apple_act/checkpoints/last/pretrained_model \
  --dataset-path /ubt_IL/dataset/tienkung_dex_sim_pick_apple \
  --episodes 5 \
  --inference-freq 1 \
  --plot \
  --plot-dir /ubt_IL/scripts/eval/output/eval_tienkung_dex_sim_pick_apple_act \
  --output /ubt_IL/scripts/eval/output/eval_tienkung_dex_sim_pick_apple_act/results.json \
  --device cuda

--inference-freq 1 means step-by-step inference, closest to deployment behavior; the default queues by n_action_steps.

Argument Description --policy-path Trained ACT checkpoint (the pretrained_model directory) --dataset-path LeRobot dataset root (containing meta/info.json) --episodes Number of episodes to evaluate (default: all) --inference-freq Run inference every N steps to emulate the deployment chunk queue; 1 means every step --plot / --plot-dir Per-episode prediction-vs-ground-truth plots (PNG) --output Result JSON (summary + per-episode MSE) --device cuda (default; falls back to cpu when unavailable)

Offline MSE is only for ranking checkpoints from the same training run. The final criterion remains /sim/task_completed in simulation or task success on hardware.

docs.title: 6. Model deployment
docs.text:
Script: /ubt_IL/scripts/deploy/tienkung_dex/rollout.sh (starts Bridge2 automatically). Prerequisite: run robot_ready.sh to move to the ready pose before running the policy; the order must not be reversed. A dimension precheck (policy action dimension vs JOINT_CONFIG) runs before deployment.

Deployment command:

POLICY_PATH=<checkpoint pretrained_model directory> \
JOINT_CONFIG=tienkung_dex_20 \
CAMERA_PORT=5758 FPS=15 DURATION=60 \
  bash /ubt_IL/scripts/deploy/tienkung_dex/rollout.sh

Deployment guides:

  • Simulation deployment: Simulation workflow · Model deployment (sim)
  • Real-robot deployment (BrainCo 13D verified): Real-robot workflow · Model deployment (real)
  • On-robot deployment (Thor, no container): On-robot deployment

Common environment variables:

Variable Default Description POLICY_PATH Required Checkpoint directory (containing config.json) JOINT_CONFIG tienkung_dex_20 tienkung_dex_20 (Inspire 13 rad) / tienkung_dex_brainco_13 (BrainCo 6 motors) / tienkung_dex_inspire_13 (Inspire 6D 0~1 → 13 codes); must match the training DOF HAND_VARIANT Empty Empty follows JOINT_CONFIG; if set explicitly, the two must agree HAND_ACTION_MODE Empty (auto) Empty derives from JOINT_CONFIG; set rad13 / pico6 explicitly when debugging FPS 15 Control loop rate (= dataset frame rate; use FPS=30 for 30 fps datasets) DURATION 60 Run time (seconds) TASK pick apple Task description CAMERA_PORT 5758 Simulation 5758 (ubt_sim publishes JPEG) / hardware 5558 (Bridge2 transcodes) IMAGE_ENABLED 0 Set 1 on hardware so Bridge2 encodes the head camera as JPEG MAX_RELATIVE_TARGET Empty (unlimited) Per-step relative target limit in rad; 0.01 recommended for the first hardware run INFERENCE_TYPE sync Only sync is supported (the Dex bridge has no chunk consumer) ZMQ_HOST 127.0.0.1 Bridge address (use the peer IP for cross-machine deployment)

See Real-robot workflow §6 for all parameters, the three hand representations, and Bridge2 group switches.

docs.title: 7. FAQ
docs.text: Symptom Fix Normalization explodes during training (QUANTILES NaN/Inf) Constant dimensions in the data; Dex uses only the right arm 7 + right hand, and constant dimensions are already dropped in the conversion config Trajectory contains long stationary segments; the policy stops during deployment Add TRIM_STATIONARY=1 during conversion (disabled by default; run STATIONARY_DIAGNOSE=1 first to inspect the distribution) Hand does not move / fingers globally misaligned HAND_VARIANT / JOINT_CONFIG does not match the physical hand, or the plugin and Bridge2 constant copies have drifted (Bridge2 logs "channel table mismatch") No camera image during deployment Simulation: check whether 5758 has a stream. Hardware: check whether Bridge2 runs with --enable-image and uses port 5558 Robot does not move in simulation Check ROS_DOMAIN_ID matches simulation (ubt_sim defaults to 0), whether robot_ready.sh ran first, and reset the scene with /sim/cmd_reset Arm hits the table right after starting robot_ready.sh was not run, or --stage-durations forced the motion to be too fast Inference service rejects load Dex does not support model hot-swap; shutdown and launch again Training raises FileExistsError OUTPUT_DIR already exists with RESUME=false; use a new directory or delete the old one Training runs out of memory Reduce BATCH_SIZE; close simulation first if it is occupying GPU memory

docs.title: Walker TienKung Dex Real-Robot Workflow: Collect -> Convert -> Train -> Evaluate -> Deploy
docs.text: Robot: Walker TienKung Dex ✅ Verified on hardware (Nov 2026): the full loop works with BrainCo 13D (right arm 7 + right hand 6, 30 fps) real-robot data. The steps are the same for both hands; only the hand variant / JOINT_CONFIG / conversion config differ.
